child_list.content: A pony crosses the river
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content: One day, the mother horse asked a pony to send rice to his aunt. The pony picked up the rice and ran quickly to his aunt’s home. Suddenly, a river blocked the way. At this time, he saw an old cow and a squirrel. He asked, “Is the river deep?” The squirrel said, “It’s too deep to cross.” But the old cow said it was very shallow. He didn’t know how to do it and ran back to ask his mother. Mother kindly said to him, “Why not try?” He returned to the river and slowly went down the river. He found that the river was neither deep nor shallow.

child_list.content: 小马过河
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
一天，马妈妈让小马把大米送给他的姑姑。小马驮起大米，飞快地往姑姑家跑去。突然，一条河阻挡了去路。这时，他看见一头老牛和一只松鼠。他问：“这条河深吗？”松鼠说：“这条河太深了，过不去。”但是老牛说这条河很浅。 他不知该怎么办，跑回去问妈妈。妈妈亲切地对

他说：“为什么不试试？”他返回河边，

慢慢地下河。他发现这条河不深也不浅。

child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
